text:
hana: quick: onboarding reported mismatched request ids across SDKs and an exported span leaked an email. raising here to align on a fix. :grimacing:

ravi: ugh. two problems: naming/propagation and redaction scope. propose canonical `request_id` (snake_case). SDKs accept incoming `x-request-id` header, generate if missing, set response header, put in OTEL baggage, span attr `request_id`, and structured log context.

zoe: +1. also default exporter settings should avoid sending DEBUG bodies. suggest `min_export_level: info` and `capture_bodies: false` so devs don't accidentally export payloads.

ravi: for redaction, current redactors run only when formatting logs. we need same rule set applied to span attributes and OTLP payloads. SDK API shape idea: `telemetry.redaction_rules` plus hooks `telemetry.pre_process_span(span)` and `telemetry.pre_export_batch(batch)`. default pre_export should scrub span attrs/events/resource attrs.

hana: sanity check: small snippet we'll add to sample-apps (python FastAPI):
```py
async def mw(req, call_next):
  rid = req.headers.get('x-request-id') or str(uuid.uuid4())
  baggage.set_baggage('request_id', rid)
  structlog.threadlocal.bind_threadlocal(request_id=rid)
  resp = await call_next(req)
  resp.headers['x-request-id'] = rid
  return resp
```

zoe: node express similar; and add test that sends `email: test@example.com` and asserts exported OTLP JSON contains no emails and that `request_id` matches log lines and span attrs.

telemetry-ci: CI telemetry-integration job 401 failed: node_redaction.integration found `test@example.com` in span attribute `http.request.body`.

sdk-bot: Note: open PR #789 added a log-only redactor to sdk-js. It needs the pre_export hook to be effective.

hana: action items: ravi -> draft RFC for `request_id` canonicalization + SDK hooks + config defaults; zoe -> node pre_export_batch hook + integration test; i'll do python middleware + unit test; i'll also draft the conservative redaction set (email, ssn, api_key, credit_card) and a regex-based default. aim to have PRs in 48h. :rocket:
